# @ripwords/myinvois-client

> TypeScript client for Malaysia's MyInvois (LHDN) e-invoicing API: UBL document building, XAdES (JSON profile) digital signing, submission, polling, cancellation/rejection, taxpayer validation, runtime code lists, and built-in per-clientId rate limiting with automatic 429 Retry-After back-off. Node.js runtime (also runs on Bun). Malaysia MyInvois only — Singapore InvoiceNow/Peppol is out of scope.

Install: `npm install @ripwords/myinvois-client`. Root export: `MyInvoisClient` (create via `MyInvoisClient.create({ clientId, clientSecret, environment: 'sandbox' | 'production', certificatePem, privateKeyPem, onBehalfOf?, rateLimitStore?, tokenStore?, retryOn429? })` or `MyInvoisClient.fromP12(clientId, clientSecret, environment, p12PathOrBuffer, passphrase)`; to combine a P12 with stores, call `getPemFromP12(p12, passphrase)` and pass the PEMs to `create`). `extractCertificateInfo(pem)` returns `{ issuerName, serialNumber }`. Login is lazy and automatic (OAuth2 client credentials, token cached per represented taxpayer with 60s refresh margin, single-flight). Signing helpers `buildSignedDocument`/`client.buildSignedDocuments` return `{ format: 'JSON', document (base64 wire bytes), documentHash (sha256 hex), codeNumber, signedDocument }` for the store-then-submit pattern; `submitDocument` accepts plain documents or these prebuilt payloads byte-for-byte. Every non-OK API response throws `MyInvoisApiError` (an `Error` subclass with `.status`, `.body` and `.apiError`, the parsed LHDN error when present); a 429 that outlasts `retryOn429` throws its subclass `MyInvoisRateLimitError` with `.retryAfterMs`; `verifyTin` returns false only on HTTP 404 and throws on other failures; `getSubmissionStatus` retries network/404/429/5xx errors (a just-accepted submission is briefly 404) and throws other 4xx. Runtime code tables (TAX_TYPES, CLASSIFICATION_CODES, STATE_CODES, COUNTRY_CODES, CURRENCY_CODES, E_INVOICE_TYPES, PAYMENT_MODES, UNIT_TYPES, MSIC_CODES) are a separate subpath: `@ripwords/myinvois-client/codes`.

Client methods → endpoints: submitDocument → POST /api/v1.0/documentsubmissions; getSubmissionStatus(submissionUid, pollInterval=3000, maxRetries=10) polls GET /api/v1.0/documentsubmissions/{uid} (Valid/PartiallyValid/Invalid all terminal); cancelDocument/rejectDocument(uuid, reason) → PUT /api/v1.0/documents/state/{uuid}/state; getDocument(uuid) → GET .../documents/{uuid}/raw; getDocumentDetails(uuid) → GET .../documents/{uuid}/details (validation steps); searchDocuments(params) → GET .../documents/search (needs complete date window); getRecentDocuments → GET .../documents/recent; getDocumentQrCode(uuid, longId?) → share URL; verifyTin(tin, idType, idValue) → GET .../taxpayer/validate/{tin}; searchTin({taxpayerName?, idType?, idValue?}) → GET .../taxpayer/search/tin; getTaxpayerQRCode(qrText) → GET .../taxpayers/qrcodeinfo/{token}; getDocumentTypes/getDocumentType(id)/getDocumentTypeVersion(id, vid) → GET .../documenttypes...; getNotifications(params) → GET .../notifications/taxpayer returning { result, metadata }; updateOnBehalfOf(tinOrTinColonRob) switches the represented taxpayer.

## Docs

- [Getting Started](/guide/getting-started.md): install, client creation, environments, first submission
- [Signing & Submission](/guide/signing.md): XAdES JSON signing, build-store-submit pattern, polling, low-level helpers
- [Rate Limiting & Stores](/guide/rate-limiting.md): official limits table, 429 back-off, injectable RateLimitStore/TokenStore for multi-process deployments
- [Intermediaries](/guide/intermediaries.md): onBehalfOf with TIN or TIN:ROB, runtime switching
- [Runtime Code Lists](/guide/codes.md): the nine official code tables under the /codes subpath
- [Error Handling](/guide/errors.md): MyInvoisApiError (status/body/apiError), MyInvoisRateLimitError (retryAfterMs), verifyTin semantics, submission errors
- [Certificates](/guide/certificates.md): approved CAs, required fields (organizationIdentifier, SERIALNUMBER, Document Signing EKU), dev certs
- [API Reference overview](/api/index.md): full method-to-endpoint coverage map with official-doc links
- [Client & Authentication](/api/client.md): create/fromP12/constructor options, token behaviour, buildSignedDocuments
- [Document Submission](/api/document-submission.md): submitDocument, getSubmissionStatus
- [Document Management](/api/document-management.md): cancel, reject, get, details, search, recent, QR URL
- [Taxpayer Validation](/api/taxpayer-validation.md): verifyTin, searchTin, getTaxpayerQRCode
- [Document Types & Notifications](/api/platform.md): getDocumentTypes, getDocumentType, getDocumentTypeVersion, getNotifications

## Official LHDN references

- [MyInvois SDK home](https://sdk.myinvois.hasil.gov.my/): authoritative API documentation
- [e-Invoice API index](https://sdk.myinvois.hasil.gov.my/einvoicingapi/): submit, cancel, reject, get, search, TIN, QR endpoints
- [Platform API index](https://sdk.myinvois.hasil.gov.my/api/): login, document types, notifications
- [Invoice v1.1 structure](https://sdk.myinvois.hasil.gov.my/documents/invoice-v1-1/): document field reference
- [Signature creation (JSON)](https://sdk.myinvois.hasil.gov.my/signature-creation-json/): the signing profile this library implements
- [Code tables](https://sdk.myinvois.hasil.gov.my/codes/): tax types, MSIC, UOM, currencies, states, countries
- [Integration practices](https://sdk.myinvois.hasil.gov.my/integration-practices/): rate limits and polling guidance
